name: zinput_bindmap_context_get_command_by_secondary_key
description: zInput_BindMapContext::GetCommandBySecondaryKey returns the command id recorded in the secondary keyboard reverse lookup table.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x470ad0 loads keyboardKey from the stack and returns self->m_secondaryKeyToCommand[keyboardKey] from this + 0x1f8c.

Native smoke zinput_bindmap_context_smoke verifies direct context lookup after RebuildLookupIndices clears a secondary key mapping, and verifies current-context secondary-key lookup after binding records and SetSecondaryKeyBinding update the reverse lookup table.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x470ad0 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a zInput bind-map accessor pass.
